name: Exterior Fiber Cement Siding Finish Coat 1
intent: Finish coat 1. Spray 300 SF/hr (spray-only, no backroll on FC), brush/roll 100 SF/hr.
doctrine: Finish coat 1 for fiber cement siding. Spray 300 SF/hr — spray-only, NO back-rolling on FC (introduces unwanted stipple on factory-smooth surface). Brush/roll 100 as fallback. Profile modifier (lap=1.0, panel=1.10, shingle=2.0) and texture modifier apply. No intercoat sanding.
